description: Call this to confirm exactly which model the person means before checking or buying ("which Galaxy S25 is this?") or to read a product's structured specs: looks it up by name or model number and returns its specs, what it accepts (mounts, battery platforms, cartridges, protocols) and what it fits. When the text matches several models it returns them all as candidates (ambiguous: true) so you can ask the person which one. For a yes/no fit answer use check_compatibility instead.
name: resolve_product
title: Look up a product
